parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all incident action types configured for the specified company. Supports filtering by active status, ID, and last-updated timestamp.

parameters.name: filters[active]
parameters.description: If true, returns item(s) with a status of 'active'.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort results by the specified field.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique identifier for this incident action type.

name.description: Display name of the action type, localized to the requester's language preference. Common examples include Corrective, Preventative, and custom names.

name_key.description: Untranslated key for the action type name. Use this value for programmatic comparisons rather than the localized name field.

active.description: Represents whether an Incident Action Type is available for use.

global.description: Represents whether an Incident Action Type has been provided by Procore.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this action type was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update to this action type.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
